args.script:
cat > solve.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Get current date in days since epoch
current_date=$(date +%s)
seven_days=$((7 * 24 * 60 * 60))

# Function to check if a number is prime
is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ $n -lt 2 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [ $n -eq 2 ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le $n ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then
            return 1
        fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

total_sum=0

for file in log_files/log_server_*; do
    # Extract server ID and date from filename
    filename=$(basename "$file")
    # Format: log_server_X_YYYY-MM-DD.txt
    server_id=$(echo "$filename" | sed 's/log_server_\([0-9]*\)_.*/\1/')
    file_date=$(echo "$filename" | sed 's/log_server_[0-9]*_\([0-9-]*\).*/\1/')
    
    # Check if server ID is prime
    if ! is_prime "$server_id"; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if file was created within the last 7 days
    file_date_seconds=$(date -d "$file_date" +%s 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -z "$file_date_seconds" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    diff=$((current_date - file_date_seconds))
    if [ $diff -gt $seven_days ]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Sum integers in the file
    while read -r num; do
        if [ -n "$num" ]; then
            total_sum=$((total_sum + num))
        fi
    done < "$file"
done

echo "$total_sum"
EOF
chmod +x solve.sh
bash solve.sh
